basics.title: Senior Software Engineer @ TechCorp | Fullstack Developer | React | Node.js | TypeScript

work.summary: Leading the development of a multi-tenant SaaS platform with a focus on scalability, security, and user experience, while mentoring engineers through code reviews and pairing sessions.
highlights: Designed a microservices architecture that reduced average deployment time from 45 minutes to 8 minutes.
Improved application performance through layered caching and code splitting, cutting page load times by up to 55%.
Built an internal component-based design system adopted by 4 different product teams.
Mentored 5 junior engineers through weekly pairing sessions and structured code reviews.

work.summary: Built a variety of web applications for clients in retail, education, and logistics industries, from database design to user interface implementation.
highlights: Developed 12+ client web applications with an average client satisfaction rating of 4.8 out of 5.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines automating testing and deployment to Vercel and AWS.
Migrated a monolithic system to a modular architecture, reducing new feature development time by 40%.
Authored comprehensive technical documentation that cut developer onboarding time from 2 weeks to 4 days.

work.summary: First industry software experience, building the UI of a project management application and collaborating in an agile workflow.
highlights: Implemented 20+ reusable UI components using React and TypeScript.
Fixed 30+ user-reported interface bugs during the internship cycle.
Participated in product team sprint planning and weekly retrospectives.
Thesis: “Applying Progressive Web Apps for Online Learning in High Schools”.
Programming laboratory assistant for 3 semesters.
Head of technology division for the faculty science event.

projects.name: TaskFlow
projects.description: Collaborative task management application with a real-time kanban board, time tracking, and calendar integration for mid-sized product teams.
highlights: Built a WebSocket-based real-time kanban board that syncs across all devices in <100ms.
Implemented virtualized lists to handle 10,000+ cards without performance degradation.
Designed an offline-first mode with automatic synchronization once connectivity returns.

projects.name: ShopEase

highlights: Built a checkout flow with a 68% conversion rate through iterative UX optimization.

Reduced database load by 70% through Redis caching on the product catalog.

highlights: Built a multi-modal search interface with dynamic filters and no page reloads.
Integrated interactive maps for bus and train seat selection.
Achieved a Lighthouse score of 95+ for performance and accessibility.

highlights: Implemented real-time courier tracking with maps and dynamic time estimates.
Built a menu recommendation system based on user order history.
Optimized bundle size so the app stays lightweight on lower-end devices.
